description: Employers in Saudi Arabia and the UAE expect the proportion of work tasks delivered autonomously by technology to reach 45% by 2030.

instances.assertion: In Saudi Arabia, the proportion of work tasks delivered autonomously by technology is projected to reach 45% by 2030.
The proportion of workers in occupations with high levels of AI task usage is stable at approximately 11% for augmentation and 70% for automation.
Employers in Saudi Arabia and the UAE expect the proportion of work tasks delivered autonomously by technology to reach 45% by 2030.
